notes: Bounded aggregate counts/us/max payload units only. Timers are nested/inclusive; do not sum across categories. Recursive copyValue and original fingerprint closure unchanged. No workflow, grant, source result or timeout change.

measurements.units: UTF-16 code units from original payload.length or plan.payloadUnits; zero means unknown/unmeasured, not necessarily empty
measurements.time: cumulative microseconds plus local health/context elapsed milliseconds
measurements.interpretation: Timers overlap: clone contains copy-root; observe contains decode/plan; currentSnapshot(s) contains copy/materialization; digest contains canonical. Compare per-group deltas, never sum overlapping counters.

originalOperations: No source, original producer function binding, outcome, namespace grant, persistence fence or timeout was replaced. Recursive copyValue and fingerprint copy closure are byte-identical to the source.
stdout: Both original fixture layers forward only /^SF_IMPORT_TRACE [a-z0-9-]+$/ to stdout. All emitted variable values are numeric counters/durations or static labels. No payload, headers, credentials or private body is logged.
